messages.text: IF-009: GET/PUT /api/preferences now carry reevaluationIntervalDays (60|90|120|180, default 90) and tourSeenVersion (integer 0..99, default 0). Both are optional on PUT, stored as text under reevaluation_interval_days and tour_seen_version, and a stored value outside the accepted set reads as the default. The interval outside the four options answers 400 validation_failed with the field name. PreferencesView and the client type Preferences now require both fields.

shared/domain/followUp.ts already existed from an earlier phase (reevaluationOf, daysBetweenIsoDates, addDaysToIsoDate, isReevaluationInterval, REEVALUATION_INTERVAL_OPTIONS, DEFAULT_REEVALUATION_DAYS); existing exports are unchanged. Added formatDays(n), reevaluationCountdown(reevaluation) -> {amount, relation, text} ('83 dias até 23/10/2026' / '9 dias de atraso desde 23/10/2026'; '1 dia' singular, due day itself is '0 dias até') and reevaluationTimeline(lastDay, today, dueDate) -> {last, today, next, text} from ISO days ('Último: .. · Hoje: .. · Próximo: ..'). homeService and the home screens can import these instead of formatting the dates themselves.

The home/consultant lanes should read the interval through GET /api/preferences (or preferenceService.get().reevaluationIntervalDays) rather than a fixed 90; portfolioService still uses OVERDUE_DIAGNOSIS_DAYS = DEFAULT_REEVALUATION_DAYS and is not part of this unit. The OnboardingTour should compare tourSeenVersion with 2 and PUT { tourSeenVersion: 2 } when the 5-step tour is closed; the tourSeen flags of each mode are untouched by this unit.
